part: Part I: The Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and the President of Zanzibar
title: Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and his authority
content: (3) In addition to his other powers, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall have the power to appoint and assign responsibilities to Ministers and Deputy Ministers of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.
subArticles: (3) In addition to his other powers, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall have the power to appoint and assign responsibilities to Ministers and Deputy Ministers of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.
